scope.label: AUTHENTICATED TRANSPORT COMPONENT WITH TEST-INJECTED SESSION KEYS

s1_1_ownership.corrigendum: Prior reporting said ReceiverHost 'delegates to the core'. It does NOT compose a ReceiverControlCore. It re-uses the single-source BootstrapEchoResponder policy; session lookup / AEAD open / decode / seal are separate code paths calling the same primitives on their own instances.
s1_1_ownership.full_core_delegation_reason: ReceiverHost demuxes h_ext from the wire and owns tombstone grace, cold admission and block assembly; wrapping the core would duplicate the session map or force cold-RX state through a component that excludes it. Directive forbids refactor for terminology alone.

at_most_one_echo_producer_per_probe.mechanism: single pending Option<u16> slot; take_pending drains once; commit is the only accounting path

s1_1_ownership.two_responder_risk: Structurally possible only if the same datagram for the same h_ext were fed to both a ReceiverControlCore and a ReceiverHost in one process. No such composition exists. Recorded as a PRODUCT-RUNTIME-INTEGRATION composition rule: exactly one responder owner per session.

control_id_is_not_aead_nonce.evidence: protector.rs:36 nonce96(full_pn)=[0x00000000 || LE64(full_pn)]; sole call sites nonce_for(args.wire_pn) at :269 and nonce_for(candidate) at :334

control_id_is_not_aad_input.evidence: aad.rs:16-24 AAD = AAD_DS || h_ext || EXTENDED_V1 || wire_flags || pn_trunc; control_id occurrences in aad.rs = 0

sealing_uses_separate_monotone_counter.evidence: SealArgs.wire_pn + last_sealed_pn[epoch]; non-monotonic refused as WireError::SealInput('non-monotonic wire_pn (nonce-reuse guard)'); SEND_PN_CAP

probe_echo_outside_control_id_issue_gate.evidence: control_id_gate.rs:4-9 producer inventory 0x10..0x18 only; core issue_gate refs = 0; host emit_cs_echo no longer calls issue()

probe_echo_outside_inbound_control_id_de.evidence: receiver_host.rs:342-361 returns before slot.dedup.check(control_id); core has no dedup window; InboundControlDedup has no production consumer

same_control_id_both_directions_no_nonce.evidence: send_cipher from send_key, recv_cipher from recv_key; identical plaintext at identical wire_pn yields different ciphertext; cross-direction open fails

probe_seq_is_authoritative_correlation.evidence: Event::CsProbeEcho carries probe_seq only; sender.rs:2341 rejects seq != probe_seq

s1_3_session_capacity.eviction: none (no LRU, no TTL, no silent replacement)
s1_3_session_capacity.reinstall_semantics: replaces that handle's session and resets its responder (rekey path, not eviction)
